transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. __. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. Well, what brings me in is I just keep messing up little things. It's nothing huge, but it's getting a bit frustrating. 

Like, I'll write down the wrong time on a sign-up sheet for a class at the senior center. Or I'll be working on a project, measure a board, and still end up cutting it a hair short because I just kind of skipped over the small print on the tape measure. It's just... careless mistakes like that, really.
Have these kinds of mistakes been going on for a long time, or are they something new for you?

Well, I'd say it's been noticeably interfering with my day-to-day stuff since we moved into our condo. That was right about a year and a month ago. I might have done it a little bit before then, I don't know, but it really started getting in the way after that move.
Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
No, I've never had any kind of head injury or concussion. Nothing like that.
Have you had similar problems with paying attention or careless mistakes since childhood?

Yeah, I suppose I have. Even back in elementary school, my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was a bright kid, but... I was always forgetting my books or losing my homework. I'd just kind of sit there and stare out the window unless someone was right there to keep me on track. So, yeah, it's been around for a long time.
